template.name: IU Range Trading
template.entry_long: close > donchian_high_prev(high,{p0}) and high - low <= {p0} * atr(high,low,close,{p1})
template.notes: A prior 10-bar high break while the bar stays within 1.75 ATR(14) approximates the narrow-range breakout condition. The ATR target factor 2.0 is dynamic, and trailing-stop state cannot be encoded.
